subject: ela
intro: Twelfth graders analyze a complex set of ideas or sequence of events and explain how specific individuals, ideas, or events interact and develop over the course of the text. They trace chains of influence in complex topics.

items.prompt:
Read.

A new printing technology lowered book costs, which spread literacy, which created a public that demanded political reform.

Trace how the factors INTERACT.

steps: I follow the chain: technology -> cheaper books -> literacy -> an informed public -> reform demands.
So each factor sets up and causes the next.
solution.answer: Each factor causes the next: cheap printing to literacy to an informed public to reform.

items.prompt:
Read.

A thinker's new economic idea persuaded reformers, whose policies reshaped how nations traded.

How do idea, individuals, and events interact?

steps: The idea persuaded reformers; their policies (events) changed trade.
So the idea drove individuals whose actions changed events.
solution.answer: The idea persuaded reformers whose policies then reshaped trade.

items.prompt: Why trace how factors INTERACT over a text?

steps: Complex topics unfold as chains of influence.
So tracing the interactions reveals how the whole situation developed.
solution.answer: It reveals how the whole complex situation developed.

items.prompt: One factor affecting another is an ____.
A chain of causes and effects is a ____.
Ideas and events develop over the ____ of a text.
